name: High-Poly 3D Model of Modern Game & Render Ready
author: muhamedbiri111
description:
Bring realism and style to your projects with this high-quality 3D model of a modern electric SUV. Designed with attention to detail, this model features a sleek aerodynamic body, full interior and exterior geometry, and photo-realistic PBR materials. Ideal for visualizations, animations, automotive design, and games.

Key Features:
	•	Clean, optimized topology
	•	Fully detailed interior & exterior
	•	4K PBR textures (Base Color, Roughness, Metalness, Normal, AO)
	•	Realistic materials: metal body, glass, rubber, leather
	•	Game-ready and render-ready formats
	•	Includes .FBX, .OBJ, .GLTF/.GLB, and native .BLEND file
	•	Scaled to real-world units (meters)

Perfect For:
✔️ Car commercials
✔️ Games & simulators
✔️ VR/AR environments
✔️ Concept presentations
✔️ Architectural or urban scenes
